verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a fair question for an AI model/API platform, since such platforms can plausibly ship scheduled tasks. None of the evidence documents any scheduler, cron-style trigger, or recurring workflow feature. The pack covers API compatibility, JSON output, caching, rate limits, function calling, streaming and the Harness developer preview, none of which provide recurring execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
